verdict.rationale: There is a single mention of encryption and two-factor authentication (256-bit AES encryption, 2FA) for securing mail, but this comes from a third-party (LegalZoom) page rather than first-party documentation, and no evidence addresses facility physical security controls or staff screening/background checks. missing for 10: facility physical security details, staff screening/vetting policies, first-party documentation of encryption practices, compliance certifications (e.g., SOC2).
